SQL.Strings: select * from (
SELECT
'MƏDAXİL' operationtype,
'Xarici Ölkədən Mədaxil' name,
C.NEREZIDENT,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)      THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) AS custtype,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS custtypeid,
(CASE WHEN C.NEREZIDENT=1               THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END) AS rezident,
(CASE WHEN E.id in(1,2)                 THEN 'Malların ixracı üzrə' ELSE E.NAME END) AS Transfertype,
(CASE WHEN E.id in(1,2)                 THEN -1  ELSE E.id END) AS Transfertypeid,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=0              THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AZN,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=1              THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS USD,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=1              THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS USDEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=45             THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS EUR,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=45             THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS EUREKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=50             THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GBP,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=50             THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS GBPEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=792            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS TRY,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=792            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS TRYEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=48             THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS RUR,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=48             THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS RUREKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=981            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GEL,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=981            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS GELEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=784            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AED,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=784            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS AEDEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD= 16            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS YEN,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD= 16            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS YENEKV
FROM exp_incomingreport T,customers C,exp_report E,operkurs O
Where
T.optype IN (4,8)
AND
AND T.reportid IN (SELECT id FROM exp_report WHERE settypeid =133)
AND T.senddate >=:bdat
AND T.senddate <=:edat
AND T.kliid=C.id
AND C.cust_type in(0,1,2,3,4)
AND T.status = 1
AND T.reportid=E.id
AND E.type=0
AND T.val_cod=O.val_kod
AND O.dat=:edat
AND T.sendtransid in(select id from provarch where dat>=:bdat and dat<=:edat)
group by
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)  THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) ,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ,
(CASE WHEN C.NEREZIDENT=1           THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END),
(CASE WHEN E.id in(1,2)             THEN 'Malların ixracı üzrə' ELSE E.NAME END),
(CASE WHEN E.id in(1,2)             THEN -1  ELSE E.id END),
C.NEREZIDENT
union
SELECT
'MƏXARİC' operationtype,
'Xarici Valyuta(Köçürmə)' name,
C.NEREZIDENT,
78 id,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)      THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) AS custtype,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS custtypeid,
(CASE WHEN C.NEREZIDENT=1               THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END) AS rezident,
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)               THEN 'Malların idxalı üzrə' ELSE E.NAME END) AS Transfertype,
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)               THEN 0  ELSE E.id END) AS Transfertypeid,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=0              THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AZN,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=1              THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS USD,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=1              THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS USDEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=45             THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS EUR,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=45             THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS EUREKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=50             THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GBP,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=50             THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS GBPEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=792            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS TRY,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=792            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS TRYEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=48             THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS RUR,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=48             THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS RUREKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=981            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GEL,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=981            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS GELEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=784            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AED,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=784            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS AEDEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD= 16            THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS YEN,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD= 16            THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS YENEKV
FROM exp_batchs T,customers C,exp_report E,operkurs O
Where
T.optype IN (4,8)
AND
AND T.reportid IN (SELECT id
FROM exp_report
WHERE settypeid = 78)
AND T.senddate >=:bdat
AND T.senddate <=:edat
AND T.kliid=C.id
AND C.cust_type in(0,1,2,3,4)
AND T.status = 1
AND T.reportid=E.id
AND E.type=0
AND T.val_cod=O.val_kod
AND O.dat=:edat
AND T.sendtransid in(select id from provarch where dat>=:bdat and dat<=:edat)
group by
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)  THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) ,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE in(1,2,3,4)  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ,
(CASE WHEN C.NEREZIDENT=1           THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END),
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)           THEN 'Malların idxalı üzrə' ELSE E.NAME END),
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)           THEN 0  ELSE E.id END),
C.NEREZIDENT
order by operationtype,Transfertypeid )
SELECT CASE WHEN T4.ID=78 THEN 'MEXARIC'
WHEN T4.ID=133 THEN 'MEDAXIL' END AS operationtype,
T4.NAME ,
T4.ID,
T2.nerezident,
(CASE WHEN T2.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) AS custtype,
(CASE WHEN T2.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS custtypeid,
(CASE WHEN T2.NEREZIDENT=1 THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END) AS rezident,
(CASE WHEN T3.id in(14,26)  THEN 'Malların idxalı üzrə' ELSE T3.NAME END) AS Transfertype,
(CASE WHEN T3.id in(14,26)  THEN 0  ELSE T3.id END) AS Transfertypeid,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AZN,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=1    THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS USD,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS USDEKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=45   THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS EUR,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS EUREKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=50   THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GBP,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS GBPEKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=792  THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS TRY,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS TRYEKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=48   THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS RUR,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS RUREKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=981  THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GEL,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS GELEKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=784  THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AED,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS AEDEKV,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD= 16  THEN T1.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS YEN,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VAL_COD=0    THEN T1.AMOUNT* T5.OSTAT  ELSE 0 END) AS YENEKV
FROM  EXP_BATCHS T1 INNER JOIN CUSTOMERS T2 ON  T1.KLIID=T2.ID
INNER JOIN EXP_REPORT T3 ON T3.ID=T1.REPORTID
INNER JOIN exp_settingstype T4 ON T1.SETID=T4.ID
INNER JOIN OPERKURS T5 ON  T1.VAL_COD=T5.VAL_KOD AND T5.DAT=:edat
WHERE  T1.SENDDATE BETWEEN :bdat AND :edat AND T2.CUST_TYPE IN (0,1,2,3) AND T1.STATUS=1
AND T3.TYPE=0
GROUP BY T4.NAME,
CASE WHEN T2.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END,
CASE WHEN T2.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
CASE WHEN T3.id in(14,26)  THEN 'Malların idxalı üzrə' ELSE T3.NAME END,
CASE WHEN T3.id in(14,26)  THEN 0  ELSE T3.id END,
T2.NEREZIDENT,
T4.ID
ORDER BY T4.NAME
SELECT
'MƏXARİC' operationtype,
'Xarici Valyuta(Köçürmə)' name,
C.NEREZIDENT,
78 id,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) AS custtype,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS custtypeid,
(CASE WHEN C.NEREZIDENT=1 THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END) AS rezident,
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)  THEN 'Malların idxalı üzrə' ELSE E.NAME END) AS Transfertype,
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)  THEN 0  ELSE E.id END) AS Transfertypeid,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=0    THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AZN,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=1    THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS USD,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=1    THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS USDEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=45   THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS EUR,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=45   THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS EUREKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=50   THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GBP,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=50   THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS GBPEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=792  THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS TRY,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=792  THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS TRYEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=48   THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS RUR,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=48   THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS RUREKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=981  THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS GEL,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=981  THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS GELEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=784  THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS AED,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD=784  THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2)  ELSE 0 END) AS AEDEKV,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD= 16  THEN T.AMOUNT  ELSE 0 END) AS YEN,
sum (CASE WHEN T.VAL_COD= 16  THEN round(T.AMOUNT*O.ostat,2) ELSE 0 END) AS YENEKV
FROM exp_batchs T,customers C,exp_report E,operkurs O
Where
T.optype IN (4,8)
AND
AND T.reportid IN (SELECT id
FROM exp_report
WHERE settypeid = 78)
AND T.senddate >=:bdat
AND T.senddate <=:edat
AND T.kliid=C.id
AND C.cust_type in(0,1,2,3)
AND T.status = 1
AND T.reportid=E.id
AND E.type=0
AND T.val_cod=O.val_kod
AND O.dat=:edat
group by
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 'FİZİKİ' ELSE 'HÜQUQİ' END) ,
(CASE WHEN C.CUST_TYPE=1  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ,
(CASE WHEN C.NEREZIDENT=1 THEN 'REZIDENT' ELSE 'QEYRİREZIDENT' END),
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)  THEN 'Malların idxalı üzrə' ELSE E.NAME END),
(CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)  THEN 0  ELSE E.id END),
C.NEREZIDENT
order by (CASE WHEN E.id in(14,26)  THEN 0  ELSE E.id END)
select val_kod,ostat from operkurs where dat=:dat
order by val_kod
